fields.description: When enabled, the matching vouchers table in the reconciliation dialog auto-shrinks for few rows and caps at 300px when there are many. Keep disabled if your workflow involves scanning long lists of vouchers at a glance.
fields.label: Compact matching vouchers table

fields.description: Restrict Customer, Supplier, and Employee selections to the reconciliation company while allowing records with a blank company as shared.
fields.label: Filter Parties by Company

fields.description: Link field on Customer that identifies the owning company.
fields.label: Customer Company Field

fields.description: Link field on Supplier that identifies the owning company.
fields.label: Supplier Company Field

fields.description: Link field on Employee that identifies the owning company.
fields.label: Employee Company Field

fields.description: When enabled, unpaid invoices in the matching dialog are listed strictly by posting date (oldest first). When disabled (default), invoices whose outstanding amount exactly matches the bank transaction are surfaced first.
fields.label: Sort unpaid invoices by posting date (FIFO)

fields.description: If checked, the unallocated amount from the bank transaction will be validated against the total of the selected unpaid invoices. If the total doesn't match, an error will be thrown.
fields.label: Validate selection against unallocated amount

fields.description: If selected, unpaid invoices are reconciled in a background job.
fields.label: Reconcile unpaid invoices in background
Evaluate bank rules hourly
fields.description: Every hour, flag new unreconciled bank transactions that match an enabled bank rule. Nothing is posted automatically: a user applies the suggestion.

fields.label: Internal transfer match window (days)
fields.description: A transfer counterpart is searched for within this many days before and after the transaction date.

fields.options: Auto reconcile links a bank transaction to an existing voucher without a click (Reconcile > Auto reconcile, or after an import). The amount must always match exactly. Tick what else a voucher must match. Everything done is logged and can be undone from History.

fields.label: Reference number must match
fields.description: Bank reference equals the voucher's reference number / cheque number.

fields.label: Party must match
fields.description: The bank transaction has a party set and the voucher is for the same party.

fields.label: Within (days)
fields.description: Voucher posting date or reference date within this many days of the bank date.

fields.label: Only when exactly one voucher qualifies
fields.description: If two or more vouchers qualify, the transaction is left for you to choose.

fields.label: Also match unpaid invoices
fields.description: Creates and submits a Payment Entry for the invoice. Off by default.

fields.label: Auto reconcile every hour
fields.description: Runs on the last 45 days of every company bank account, as Administrator. Off by default.
